instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a large baking dish with a thin layer of oil.
Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the parsley along with beef, ricotta, bread crumbs, and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
garlic
1 ½ lb lean ground beef
½ (15 oz) pkg ricotta cheese
⅔ cup panko bread crumbs
2 tsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a generous ¼-cup measure, form the beef mixture into 12 rounded meatballs and arrange in the baking dish.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until meatballs are lightly browned and nearly cooked through, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and mince onion. Peel and mince additional garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
1 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and additional spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomato sauce to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 5-6 minutes more. Cover and remove from heat.

When the meatballs are lightly browned, remove from the oven. Top with tomato sauce and sprinkle with cheese. Return to the oven and continue to bake until cheese is melted and meatballs are cooked through, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, split the rolls in half and arrange (reassembled) on a large baking sheet pan. Add to the oven and bake until toasted on the outside, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To assemble, fill each roll with a cheesy meatball and some sauce. Transfer to a serving platter and enjoy!
